title: Create-file failures are silently swallowed when no file is active (errorMsg set but never rendered, and no toast)
description: On create failure, handleCreate sets only errorMsg (lines 151 and 153) and, unlike every other async handler in this component, does NOT call addToast. errorMsg is rendered exclusively inside the `activeModule ? (...)` branch (line 269-273). When the user creates the first utility file (activeModule === null) and the request fails, the component renders the `else` branch (line 275-291, the "No utility files yet."/"Select a file" view), so errorMsg is dropped on the floor and the user gets no feedback at all. The other handlers (loadFiles line 102, loadFile line 122, autoSave line 83, handleDelete line 169) all surface failures via addToast; handleCreate is the inconsistent outlier and the only failure path with no user-visible signal in the no-active-file case.
evidence: handleCreate catch (line 148-155) sets `setErrorMsg(...)` with no addToast. errorMsg is rendered only at line 269 `{errorMsg && (...)}` which lives inside `{activeModule ? (` (line 259); the no-file branch begins at line 275 `: (` and never references errorMsg. Creating the first file with a backend error therefore shows nothing. Compare addToast usage at lines 83, 102, 122, 169.
